claims.judge_reason: Exact dense three-cell and sparse P4 constructions were real but too small to demonstrate the general framework.
The concrete P4 fiber calculation and countable control were valid but judged small-scale.
The unbounded-offset singleton counterexample contradicts the displayed formal MP_D statement, subject to acknowledged prose-interpretation risk.
The allowed L=0 case contradicts the universally quantified strict-subset clause.
The proof reconstruction had no actual MPNN evaluation, graph data, or measured approximation errors.
The exact two-point counterexample gives an unbounded uniform gap on sample imbalance, with the same formal-versus-prose risk as Claim 3.

record.overall: Claims 1 and 2 received toy credit; Claims 3, 4, and 6 received full falsification credit; Claim 5 was inconclusive because it lacked an actual MPNN experiment.
